from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486032/attempts/84bcef3cf5a14479a7d0101da055aebf/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    frame = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 5]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in frame), max(r for r, c in frame)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in frame), max(c for r, c in frame)
    midr, midc = (r0 + r1) / 2, (c0 + c1) / 2
    markers = [(r, c, value) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row)
               if value != 0 and value != 5 and not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1)]
    for r, c, color in markers:
        top = r < midr
        left = c < midc
        rr0, rr1 = (r0 + 1, (r0 + r1) // 2) if top else ((r0 + r1) // 2 + 1, r1 - 1)
        cc0, cc1 = (c0 + 1, (c0 + c1) // 2) if left else ((c0 + c1) // 2 + 1, c1 - 1)
        for rr in range(rr0, rr1 + 1):
            for cc in range(cc0, cc1 + 1):
                out[rr][cc] = color
        opp_r0, opp_r1 = (r0 + 1, (r0 + r1) // 2) if not top else ((r0 + r1) // 2 + 1, r1 - 1)
        opp_c0, opp_c1 = (c0 + 1, (c0 + c1) // 2) if not left else ((c0 + c1) // 2 + 1, c1 - 1)
        for rr in range(opp_r0, opp_r1 + 1):
            for cc in range(opp_c0, opp_c1 + 1):
                out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-00720d9c.py'
path.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code, str(path), 'exec'))
print(path)
